cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You spread yours out so confidently, I've spread ours too. Pass the poles; we'll beat the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're standing on the inner tent. Step off it; the poles clip to that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, inner first. I'll clip it up while you get the cover. Same system as yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's a pop-up. And your clips are underneath: you've laid it upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you take that end and we'll turn it. Much easier to check the clips before they're bearing any weight.

reason: Keep shelter pressure while B exposes two successive copied misunderstandings; final correction is a joint physical task.
